findings.rule: D40 (never break inside a word) and the PR #307 round 2 decision against state-in-measure auto-size
findings.trigger: TmrFitText keeps `size` in remember{mutableStateOf} and writes it from onTextLayout. Each wrong layout is drawn, and then the next frame recomposes 8% smaller. Take TmrFileCard('DeshmukhNorthwindResumePdf') at font 2.0 in 337dp: the name column is about 249dp. Frame 1 lays out at 30dp, breaks the word mid-way and draws it. It takes about 8 drawn frames of split words (30 x 0.92^n until about 16.6dp) before the name settles, and the user sees the name visibly re-wrap and shrink. The remember key (text, style, fontScale) has no constraints, so when the width grows (rotation, foldable or window resize) the size never grows back. One transient narrow measure shrinks the name permanently. The tests do not see this because the rule's waitForIdle settles all frames. The baselines do not show it because no font-200 file card baseline exists. This is the same defect #307 r2 rejected.
findings.title: TmrFitText shrinks through state written from onTextLayout: several drawn frames of split words, stale size on width change
findings.proof: Fix to converge with #307 (0205f503 TmrChromeText.kt): delete `size` and onTextLayout. Use Text(text = withBreakOpportunities(text, breakAfter), style = style, color = color, autoSize = remember(style.fontSize, fontScale) { if (fontScale > 1f) WholeWordAutoSize(style.fontSize, (style.fontSize.value / fontScale).sp) else null }, softWrap = true, maxLines = Int.MAX_VALUE, overflow = TextOverflow.Clip), wrapped in key(fontScale). WholeWordAutoSize.getFontSize loops performLayout(constraints, text, size) while size > floor && breaksInsideWord(layout), with step 0.9 as in #307 (no recorded baseline depends on 0.92). Share one primitive: move WholeWordAutoSize, breaksInsideWord, withBreakOpportunities and readAs into one internal file core/designsystem/.../component/TmrWholeWordText.kt (package component). Use this PR's breaksInsideWord as the shared predicate: #307's splitsWord does not treat ZWSP or '-' as boundaries and would flag every ZWSP break. TmrCapsText and TmrFitText both call it, and whichever lane merges into revamp/w2-all second takes the file byte-identical and deletes its private copy (the D42 pattern). Red test: in TmrContentFontScaleTest, set rule.mainClock.autoAdvance = false, setContent with TmrFileCard('DeshmukhNorthwindResumePdf') at font 2.0 in 337dp, and read the layout after the first frame only. assertFalse(breaksInsideWord(layout)) fails at the head and passes with TextAutoSize.

findings.trigger: scaledSize is layout.layoutInput.style.fontSize.value * 2f, and the assertion is fontSize < scaledSize, which is true for any positive size. The 'name did not shrink' message can never fire, and the test asserts nothing about the 1x floor its name promises.
findings.title: Shrink assertion compares the layout size with twice itself
findings.proof: Capture the start size from TmrTheme.typography.strongLarge.fontSize inside setContent. Assert that layout.layoutInput.style.fontSize < start and >= start / 2 (the 1x floor in sp at fontScale 2).

findings.title: Section label uppercase leaks into semantics
findings.proof: Set modifier = modifier.readAs(text).semantics { heading() }. A test with onNodeWithText("Tailored resumes", useUnmergedTree = true).assertExists() fails at the head and passes after the change.

findings.rule: ZWSP must not leak into accessibility
findings.trigger: readAs(text) sets the semantics Text to the clean name. Text still publishes GetTextLayoutResult, whose layout text contains a ZWSP after every _ . - /. AndroidComposeViewAccessibilityDelegateCompat pairs the semantics text with that layout for line and paragraph traversal. For 'Priya-Deshmukh_Northwind-GCC_Associate-Analyst.pdf' (6 inserted ZWSPs), TalkBack read-by-line offsets drift by up to 6 characters, so lines are cut mid-word.
findings.title: ZWSP layout is exposed under the clean semantics text
findings.proof: In the shared primitive, when breakAfter is not empty, use clearAndSetSemantics { text = AnnotatedString(source) } and do not forward getTextLayoutResult. Expose the layout to tests through an internal SemanticsPropertyKey, the TmrSpinnerAnimatedKey precedent, and update textLayouts() in the file card tests to read it.
